ruling.explanation:
Both parties' surviving evidence points the same way, and the fee cannot stand.

Why the charge fails. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02720) never places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61. His closest recorded approach across the whole trip is 53.08 m (driver_track.min_distance_m), and the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-in-radius-fix test is therefore not met, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the effective in-geofence dwell under POL-NS-06 is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02720, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) - a 180 s shortfall. Under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full. The same result follows on the wrong-face reading: the driver's closest point (53.08 m) lies outside the arrival radius but far inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and POL-NS-03 likewise refunds the fee in full.

Amount. EV-FARE-02720 shows the cancellation-fee line and total_charged at SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount refunded is that SGD 4.50 line; the SGD 6.61 gross figure is not what was charged.

Driver compensation - none. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Its anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 of completed_trips_30d 134 = 0.0075, below both the count-4 and the 0.08 rate limbs), so nothing is withheld on that ground, but there is no fee entitlement to compensate. Nor does POL-NS-03 produce goodwill: the rider named no entrance, block or sub-location (her only message is 'ok'), so limb (i) does not apply, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not the 2 or more limb (ii) requires, so the 50% pin-ambiguity payment (SGD 2.25) is not payable either.

The parties' accounts. The driver's statement 'I was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace (closest 53.08 m) and cannot carry the arrival fact; the trace governs. The rider's track (66 stationary fixes, 14.62-20.74 m from the pin) confirms she was at the pickup point. Her POL-NS-04 claim is not the ground of the refund and would not apply on its own terms anyway - 'ok' is an acknowledgement, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) requires - but the full refund she seeks is granted under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06.

Referrals - none. The arrival marker is not a POL-NS-05 false-arrival event: the driver was within 300 m of the pin (closest 53.08 m) and is not shown at 15 km/h or more at the marker, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and no other clause produces a referral on these facts.

Weight and confidence. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-02720, EV-TRIP-02720 and EV-FARE-02720, all at weight 1.0, so none of them caps confidence. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT): its absence makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulated dwell unavailable, but it carries no deciding fact, does not impair the driver's track, and does not move the cap (POL-NS-11). No POL-NS-08(a)-(d) or POL-NS-09 trigger is met. This is an automated ruling made without human review; the appeal route is POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
